function.name: Glob
function.description: Find files whose name or path matches a glob pattern. Only matches file names/paths, does not search file contents. Returns matching file paths with '/' separators. Respects .gitignore. The pattern is matched case-sensitively. Examples: 1) Find all TypeScript files under src: {'pattern':'**/*.ts','path':'src'} 2) Find all JSON files under src: {'pattern':'src/**/*.json'} 3) Find files named index.js in any folder: {'pattern':'index.js'}

pattern.description: Glob pattern. Supports '*', '?' and character classes such as '[abc]'. Patterns without a '/' match file names at any depth, e.g. '*.ts' or 'index.js'. Patterns containing '/' match the path: a leading literal directory scopes the search to that directory ('src/**/*.json'), and '**/' matches any number of directories ('**/*.ts').

path.description: Directory to search recursively. Defaults to current directory. This is the only way to restrict which directory is searched; the pattern itself cannot.

limit.description: Maximum number of file paths to return. Default 500.
